scripts.compile:webview: npm run compile:webview:chart && npm run compile:webview:results && npm run compile:webview:plugins && npm run compile:webview:profiler
scripts.check: tsc -p ./ --noEmit && tsc -p webview/chart/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/results/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/plugins/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p webview/profiler/tsconfig.json --noEmit

notes.merge: Append the webview view to contributes.views.axis-panel (beside axis.results / axis.strategy). Add onView:axis.profiler to activationEvents. Add compile:webview:profiler and include it in compile:webview + check. Do not edit this fragment into package.json from the profiler feature agent.
notes.wiring: Call registerProfilerView(context, resultsStore) from activate after registerResultsView. window.registerWebviewViewProvider('axis.profiler', provider, { webviewOptions: { retainContextWhenHidden: false } }).
notes.assets: Webview loads dist/webview/profiler/main.js + main.css (Vite IIFE, clone of results).
notes.protocol: Host posts a local { type: 'profiler.set', payload } envelope. Do NOT add profiler.set / profiler.ready to axis.webview.v1 ALL_MESSAGE_TYPES. The profiler webview also accepts results.set lastRun as a fallback.
notes.electron: src/test/extension.test.ts EXPECTED_PANEL_VIEWS currently lists axis.results + axis.strategy — wiring agent must add axis.profiler (type webview, retainContextWhenHidden false) and onView:axis.profiler when merging this fragment.
